_meta.approval: D-088 (founder, 17 Oct 2026): privacy intake gate, with conditions; follows D-084 (FD-05)
_meta.rule: The gate loads its rules from the 'controls' table below. Clause texts are HerBiz summaries in our own words, not official text; Arabic prevails for UAE law. Applicability of the UAE PDPL to HerBiz has not been determined: these principles are used as a design benchmark. Synthetic data only. Not legal advice.
changes: 0.1.1 (2026-10-17): legal-kalpu review: Art. 18 and Art. 5 summaries reworded

clauses.type: binding law; applicability to HerBiz not determined
clauses.summary: HerBiz summary, not official text; Arabic prevails: personal data should not be processed without the person's consent, except in the cases the law lists.

clauses.type: binding law; applicability to HerBiz not determined
clauses.summary: HerBiz summary, not official text; Arabic prevails: collect personal data only for a clear purpose, keep it to what that purpose needs, protect it, and do not keep it after the purpose is served unless it is anonymised.

clauses.type: binding law; applicability to HerBiz not determined
clauses.summary: HerBiz summary, not official text; Arabic prevails: people may object to decisions based on automated processing that have legal effects on them or seriously affect them, subject to exceptions the law lists; the controller must involve a person in reviewing such decisions when the person asks (Art. 18(4), read 17 Oct 2026).

clauses.type: official policy; no binding force stated
clauses.summary: HerBiz summary, not official text: AI development should keep people's privacy a top priority.

clauses.type: official policy; no binding force stated
clauses.summary: HerBiz summary, not official text: human judgement and oversight should stay in control of AI, so errors or bias can be corrected.
HerBiz internal rule: the prototype works only with synthetic data; it must not take in real people's personal details.
HerBiz internal rule: when an input is blocked, its original text is never stored, echoed, searched or logged; only the detector and control identifiers are recorded.
HerBiz internal rule: if the privacy rules cannot be loaded or checked, the input is not processed.
